enriched.summary: A aula aborda vocabulário, gramática e pronúncia em inglês, com foco no uso de verbos irregulares no passado e do verbo 'to be' no passado. Exemplos práticos e perguntas reforçam o aprendizado de estruturas e expressões comuns.
mainTopics: Uso de 'while' e 'when' em frases com ações simultâneas

vocabulary.definition: A respectful way to address a woman.
examples: Excuse me, ma’am, can you help me?
Did he drink water during the meal?

vocabulary.definition: To carry or move something from one place to another.
examples: I took the photo while they were writing a song.
I took the photo while they were writing a song.

vocabulary.definition: To wash plates, utensils, and other kitchenware.
examples: While I was doing my English class, my wife was doing the dishes.

grammar.topic: Verb 'to be' in the past tense
grammar.explanation: The verb 'to be' changes to 'was' and 'were' in the past tense depending on the subject.
rules: Interrogative forms swap subject and verb: 'Was he?' or 'Were they?'
examples: John was at the party yesterday.
Was John drunk? No, he wasn’t.
My friends were at the gym yesterday.

grammar.explanation: Irregular verbs do not follow the standard rule of adding '-ed' for past tense. Each verb has its own irregular form.
rules: Use context to decide if the sentence needs the past tense.
examples: I took the photo while they were writing a song.
commonMistakes: Using the base form instead of the past tense (e.g., 'drink' instead of 'drank').

grammar.explanation: 'While' indicates actions happening simultaneously, whereas 'when' can indicate a specific time or interrupting action.
rules: Use 'while' for two actions occurring at the same time.
Use 'when' for a specific time or interruption in an action.
examples: I took the photo while they were writing a song.
While they were writing a song, I took a photo.
When they were writing a song, I took a photo.

expressions.usage: Used when talking about cleaning utensils and kitchenware.
examples: While I was doing my English class, my wife was doing the dishes.

practiceQuestions.question: Complete the sentence: Daniel _____ pasta yesterday.
Was John at the party yesterday?
practiceQuestions.explanation: This is an affirmative answer to a question using the past tense of 'to be'.

practiceQuestions.question: What did Daniel eat for dessert?
practiceQuestions.explanation: The word 'nothing' is used to indicate he didn’t eat any dessert.

culturalNotes: In English-speaking cultures, verbs like 'do the dishes' are commonly used in daily conversations.
Using 'ma’am' is considered polite, especially in formal or professional contexts.
studyTips: Memorize the past tense forms of common irregular verbs like 'drink', 'eat', and 'take'.
Practice forming sentences using ‘while’ and ‘when’ to describe simultaneous actions.
Read and repeat examples aloud to improve pronunciation and retention.
originalExamples: Daniel ate pasta yesterday. (Daniel comeu massa ontem.)
He didn’t eat rice, beans and meat. (Ele não comeu arroz, feijão e carne.)
Did he eat two portions / servings? (Ele comeu duas porções?)
Yes, he did. (Sim, ele comeu.)
Did he drink water during the meal? (Ele bebeu água durante a refeição?)
No, he didn’t. (Não, ele não bebeu.)
What did he eat for dessert? (O que ele comeu na sobremesa?)
Nothing. (Nada.)
John was at the party yesterday. (John estava na festa ontem.)
John wasn’t at home. (John não estava em casa.)
Was John with Mary? (O John estava com a Mary?)
Yes, he was. (Sim, ele estava.)
Was John drunk? (O John estava bêbado?)
No, he wasn’t. (Não, ele não estava.)
Why was he nervous? (Por que ele estava nervoso?)
He wasn’t nervous. (Ele não estava nervoso.)
My friends were at the gym yesterday. (Meus amigos estavam na academia ontem.)
My friends weren’t in the park yesterday. (Meus amigos não estavam no parque ontem.)
Were your friends at home? (Seus amigos estavam em casa?)
No, they weren’t. (Não, eles não estavam.)
Were your friends together? (Seus amigos estavam juntos?)
Yes, they were. (Sim, eles estavam.)
How long were your friends at the gym? (Quanto tempo seus amigos estavam na academia?)
For about 1.5 hours. (Por cerca de 1.5 horas.)
When I took the photo, they were writing a song. (Quando tirei a foto, eles estavam escrevendo uma música.)
They were writing a song when I took the photo. (Eles estavam escrevendo uma música quando tirei a foto.)
While: enquanto. (While: enquanto.)
I took the photo while they were writing a song. (Eu tirei a foto enquanto eles estavam escrevendo uma música.)
While they were writing a song, I took a photo. (Enquanto eles estavam escrevendo uma música, eu tirei uma foto.)
While I was doing my English class, my wife was doing the dishes. (Enquanto fazia minha aula de inglês, minha esposa estava lavando a louça.)
